Cu or Fe-based catalysts can be used to selectively catalyse the N,N-diaryl or N-aryl monoarylation of benzazoles in the absence of any additional ligands in PEG under an inert atmosphere, and that two types of coupling products can be easily controlled by changing the type of metal salts.

we developed a novel and efficient protocol for selective N,N-diarylations of benzoxazol-2-ylamine with aryl iodide catalyzed by CuI in the presence of PEG-6000 under an inert atmosphere and N-monoarylations of benzazol-2-one with aryl iodode catalyzed by FeCl2 under the same conditions.

ligand-free Cu and Fe catalyze the selective ring opening of benzoxazol-2(3H)-ones with aryl iodide to give triphenylamine and diphenylamine products in polyethylene gly col under an inert atmosphere, respectively.

the development of new methods for the preparation of benzoxazolinones.
the development of a new method for the selective ring-opening arylation of benzoxazole derivatives with aryl iodide.
the selective ring-opening arylation of benzoxazole with aryl iodide catalyzed by Cu or Fe in polyethylene glycols.

the reaction is ligand-free, Cu- and/or Fe-catalyzed, and selective ring-opening arylation of benzoxazole with aryl iodide in PEG under inert atmosphere.
this work is an excellent addition to the field of metal-catalyzed C–H activation and arylation reactions.
the Cu-catalyzed reaction is a more efficient and practical protocol for the N,N-diarylating of benzoxazolyls.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the Cu-catalyzed N,N-diarylations of benzoxazolinones and benzoxazoles with aryl iodide are achieved in the presence of PEG-400 and the Fe-catalyzed ring-opening arylation of benzoxazole with aryl iodode is realized in PEG-400 in the absence of ligands.
the N,N-diaryl benzoxazoles were obtained in high yield under Cu catalysis, while the N-monoarylated benzoxazoles can be obtained with the use of Fe as the catalyst.

we have developed a new, ligand-free, Cu- and/or Fe-based catalyst system for the selective N,N-diarylations or N-monoarylations of benzoxazols with aryl iodide under an inert atmosphere, and a range of substrates were investigated for the diverse arylation reactions, and the coupling products were obtained in good to high yield.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Cu- or Fe-catalyzed N,N-diarylated benzoxazole can be obtained by using a ligand-free catalyst system.
the ring-opening arylation of benzoxazole with aryl iodide can be selectively catalyzed by Cu and Fe in the absence of added ligand, and the two types of coupling products can be simply controlled.
the Cu or Fe catalysts are effective in the selective N,N-diarylations or N-monoarylations of benzoxazolyl-2-carboxylic acids with aryl iodide in the absence of ligands.
